scripts.clean:port: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { const out = execSync('netstat -ano | findstr :5024').toString(); for (const l of out.trim().split('\n')) { const pid = l.trim().split(/\s+/).pop(); if (pid && parseInt(pid) > 4) try { process.kill(parseInt(pid), 'SIGKILL'); } catch (e) { try { execSync('taskkill /F /PID ' + pid); } catch (e2) {} } } console.log('Cleaned port 5024'); } catch (e) { console.log('Port 5024 is clean'); }"
